# The Interior Lab

> > A Singapore-based residential and commercial interior design firm specializing in condo, HDB, and landed property renovations with award-winning accreditations and a diverse portfolio of modern design styles.

The Interior Lab is an established interior design studio in Singapore offering comprehensive design services for residential properties (condos, HDB flats, landed homes) and commercial spaces. The firm holds multiple professional accreditations including CaseTrust, HDB, and BCA certifications, and has been featured in media outlets like Lookbox Living.

## Featured Projects

- [D'leedon III](https://www.theinteriorlab.com.sg/Project/dleedon-iii): D'leedon III project with Mediterranean Japandi design and smart home integration
- [Edelweiss Park](https://www.theinteriorlab.com.sg/Project/edelweiss-park): Edelweiss Park modern industrial design project with home office and coffee pantry
- [9 Joo Seng Road](https://www.theinteriorlab.com.sg/Project/9-joo-seng-road): 9 Joo Seng Road wabi sabi minimalist design with Japanese-inspired smart home
- [486B Tampines](https://www.theinteriorlab.com.sg/Project/486b-tampines): 486B Tampines Scandinavian Bohemian HDB renovation with open concept design
- [Normanton Park](https://www.theinteriorlab.com.sg/Project/normanton-park): Normanton Park modern eclectic three-bedroom home with Murphy bed and color palette
- [Parkedge @ Bidadari](https://www.theinteriorlab.com.sg/Project/parkedge-bidadari): Parkedge @ Bidadari modern contemporary 4-room HDB with warm neutral tones
- [Dakota Residences](https://www.theinteriorlab.com.sg/Project/dakota-residences): Dakota Residences modern French home with Vietnamese heritage design elements
